name: test-r-script-container
title: R Script Container Probe
description: Runs an inline R script in the prebuilt mediforce-agent:cdisc-case-3 image and reports the R version and library paths.

script.inlineScript:
output_dir <- Sys.getenv("MEDIFORCE_OUTPUT_DIR", unset = "/output")

has_jsonlite <- requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)

info <- list(
  ok = TRUE,
  image = "mediforce-agent:cdisc-case-3",
  rVersion = paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
  jsonliteInstalled = has_jsonlite,
  admiralInstalled = requireNamespace("admiral", quietly = TRUE),
  libPaths = .libPaths()
)

cat("probe: R", info$rVersion,
    "| jsonlite", has_jsonlite,
    "| admiral", info$admiralInstalled, "\n")

target <- file.path(output_dir, "result.json")
if (has_jsonlite) {
  write(jsonlite::toJSON(info, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE), target)
} else {
  write(
    paste(
      names(info),
      vapply(info, function(x) paste(x, collapse = ","), character(1)),
      sep = "=", collapse = "\n"
    ),
    target
  )
}
cat("wrote", target, "\n")
